argv: Read {rules} and the contract in {brief}. Do exactly what that contract requires inside {workspace}, run its validation, then write your report to {report}.
harnesses.description: Cline CLI as a bounded worker. Flags confirmed against Cline CLI 3.86.2: --data-dir gives the run its own isolated state so no global Cline configuration is touched, and the worker writes the report itself because the CLI has no output-file flag. Re-confirm the flags against your installed version; this adapter never runs the command. Its system prompt and tool definitions consume context before the brief is read: about 6805 tokens were observed on this build, declared conservatively as 7000. Re-measure it for your version; an understated overhead lets a dispatch be prepared that the worker cannot accept.

Illustrates that any harness accepting a brief and writing a report can replace Cline without changing packets or contracts. Its overhead is declared 0 only because this illustration adds no prompt of its own; a real harness must declare what it actually consumes.
